name: Export Import with Faizan
imageStyle: photorealistic cinematic photo, warm natural light, Indian export-import setting (warehouse, port, factory, office), shallow depth of field, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names on containers
story_rules: Slide 1 is a hook: a person + a surprising number or a contradiction. Never a topic label.
Every slide ends with a teaser line that opens a loop for the next slide.
Build tension for 4-6 slides, then give the payoff/fix, then the CTA.
One idea per slide, max ~25 words. Gold highlights the 1-2 words that carry meaning.
Every slide has a relevant image; all type is rendered from HTML, never by the image model.
Last slide: lead magnet CTA - 'Comment KEYWORD and I'll DM you the free <asset>' plus follow.
Label invented numbers as 'illustrative example'. Real duty rates / rules must be fact-checked.
